high_level_description: The image depicts a woman walking outdoors at night. She is wearing a black cardigan over a white polka-dotted skirt with a scalloped hem. Her outfit is completed with white knee-high socks and black Mary Jane shoes. She has long, dark hair that falls past her shoulders and is wearing large, round glasses. She carries a black handbag slung over her shoulder. In the background, there is a white Range Rover parked on what appears to be a street or parking area.
